services.name: Seattle Sailing Harbor Tour
services.desc: Join us on the harbor! Duration 2 Hours About Come aboard for a day sail on our classic schooner! Our Harbor Sailing tour is family-friendly and is an excellent way to see the Seattle skyline, the beauty of the Puget Sound, and even mountain views! We will depart from our dock at Pier 66 Bell Harbor Marina, then set our sails for a 2-hour cruise in the Puget Sound. Bay Lady is the largest public sailing vessel in Seattle. With her high railing and comfortable seating, she is the premier boat ride for families. What will we see? services.name: Evening Colors Sunset Sail
services.desc: Join us on the harbor! Duration 2 Hours About An absolute “Seattle Must Do!” We will set the sails, turn off the engine, and relax as the cool sea breeze powers us through the Puget Sound. Enjoy a drink as the sun dips down behind the Olympic Peninsula and bathes the Seattle skyline in sparkling twilight colors. This is the perfect cruise for special occasions and dates. Our amazing sailboat is the largest and most comfortable public sailing vessel in Seattle. We have comfortable seats for relaxing and wide decks to enjoy moving around the vessel. We have two restrooms and serve cider, beer, wine, champagne, soda, and water. So come on board and let’s raise a toast to an amazing sunset sail

services.name: Weekend Sailing Brunch Buffet
services.desc: Join us on the harbor! Duration 2 Hours About Weekend Sailing Brunch Buffet The only thing better than a Sunday morning sail is a Sunday morning sail with BRUNCH! Start your weekend morning off right with a morning adventure aboard Seattle’s Tall Ship as we set sail and enjoy a delicious brunch buffet. Indulge in the perfect combination of relaxation, breathtaking views, and a mouthwatering buffet prepared by Arista Catering. As you step aboard our charming vessel, you’ll be greeted with the inviting aroma of freshly brewed coffee, tea, and refreshing juice.
